name: hardware_component_history
sql:
CREATE TABLE hardware_component_history (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at REAL NOT NULL,
        component_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        change_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        component_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        old_config_json TEXT,
        new_config_json TEXT,
        summary TEXT NOT NULL
    )

name: hardware_components
sql:
CREATE TABLE hardware_components (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        category TEXT NOT NULL,
        component_key TEXT NOT NULL,
        name TEXT,
        vendor TEXT,
        model TEXT,
        serial_number TEXT,
        status TEXT,
        health_status TEXT,
        temperature_c REAL,
        capacity_bytes INTEGER,
        free_bytes INTEGER,
        first_seen TEXT NOT NULL,
        last_seen TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at REAL NOT NULL,
        specs_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
        raw_json TEXT,
        UNIQUE(category, component_key)
    )

name: incidents
sql:
CREATE TABLE incidents (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        incident_id TEXT UNIQUE,
        timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at REAL NOT NULL,
        domain TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'incident',
        trigger_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'event',
        severity TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INFO',
        title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        channel TEXT,
        event_id INTEGER,
        event_record_id INTEGER,
        provider_name TEXT,
        sensor_id TEXT,
        device_id TEXT,
        app_name TEXT,
        value REAL,
        baseline_mean REAL,
        baseline_sigma REAL,
        deviation_factor REAL,
        unit TEXT,
        window_start TEXT,
        window_end TEXT,
        duration_sec REAL DEFAULT 0.0,
        trigger_metrics_json TEXT,
        suspect_processes_json TEXT,
        related_events_json TEXT,
        metrics_summary_json TEXT,
        raw_window_json TEXT,
        message TEXT,
        details_json TEXT,
        raw_xml TEXT,
        resolved INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    )

name: inventory_changes
sql:
CREATE TABLE inventory_changes (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        domain TEXT NOT NULL,
        entity_key TEXT NOT NULL,
        change_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        detected_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        timestamp TEXT,
        created_at REAL DEFAULT 0.0,
        old_json TEXT,
        new_json TEXT,
        diff_json TEXT
    )

name: inventory_state
sql:
CREATE TABLE inventory_state (
        domain TEXT NOT NULL,
        entity_key TEXT NOT NULL,
        attrs_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
        attrs_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        first_seen TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        last_changed TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        removed_at TEXT,
        state_json TEXT,
        updated_at REAL DEFAULT 0.0,
        PRIMARY KEY (domain, entity_key)
    ) WITHOUT ROWID

name: power_sessions
sql:
CREATE TABLE power_sessions (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        session_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        record_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'session',
        boot_time TEXT NOT NULL,
        boot_timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
        shutdown_time TEXT,
        shutdown_timestamp REAL,
        uptime_seconds REAL DEFAULT 0.0,
        uptime_human TEXT,
        shutdown_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        classification TEXT,
        confidence TEXT,
        initiator TEXT,
        user TEXT,
        domain TEXT,
        process TEXT,
        process_id INTEGER,
        reason TEXT,
        reason_code TEXT,
        comment TEXT,
        summary TEXT,
        clean_shutdown INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        unexpected_shutdown INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        bugcheck TEXT,
        bugcheck_code TEXT,
        bugcheck_params_json TEXT,
        dump_file TEXT,
        boot_event_id INTEGER DEFAULT 12,
        shutdown_event_id INTEGER,
        event_id INTEGER,
        provider TEXT,
        channel TEXT,
        initiator_chain_json TEXT,
        events_json TEXT,
        evidence_json TEXT,
        details_json TEXT,
        raw_xml TEXT,
        created_at REAL NOT NULL
    )

name: process_file_events
sql:
CREATE TABLE process_file_events (
        event_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        instance_id INTEGER,
        pid INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        process_name TEXT,
        timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at REAL NOT NULL,
        operation_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        file_path TEXT NOT NULL,
        target_directory TEXT,
        bytes_transferred INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        io_rate_bytes_sec REAL DEFAULT 0.0,
        details_json TEXT
    )

name: process_lifecycle_sessions
sql:
CREATE TABLE process_lifecycle_sessions (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        instance_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        definition_id INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        parent_instance_id INTEGER,
        pid INTEGER NOT NULL,
        ppid INTEGER,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        friendly_name TEXT,
        exe_path TEXT,
        binary_hash TEXT,
        icon_base64 TEXT,
        cmdline TEXT,
        username TEXT,
        sid TEXT,
        session_id INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        integrity_level TEXT,
        parent_name TEXT,
        parent_exe TEXT,
        parent_guid TEXT,
        initiator_type TEXT,
        status TEXT DEFAULT 'RUNNING',
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_ts REAL NOT NULL,
        terminated_at TEXT,
        terminated_ts REAL,
        is_alive INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        lifetime_sec REAL DEFAULT 0.0,
        exit_code INTEGER,
        cpu_time_user_sec REAL DEFAULT 0.0,
        cpu_time_kernel_sec REAL DEFAULT 0.0,
        cpu_time_total_sec REAL DEFAULT 0.0,
        cpu_cycles INTEGER,
        peak_working_set_mb REAL DEFAULT 0.0,
        peak_private_mb REAL DEFAULT 0.0,
        io_read_bytes INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        io_write_bytes INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        io_read_ops INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        io_write_ops INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        files_accessed_json TEXT,
        remote_endpoints_json TEXT,
        raw_json TEXT
    )

name: process_snapshots
sql:
CREATE TABLE process_snapshots (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        snapshot_id INTEGER,
        sample_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'snapshot',
        instance_id TEXT,
        timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at REAL,
        pid INTEGER NOT NULL,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT,
        cpu_percent REAL,
        memory_mb REAL,
        memory_percent REAL,
        working_set_mb REAL,
        private_mb REAL,
        peak_working_set_mb REAL,
        commit_size_mb REAL,
        page_faults INTEGER,
        num_threads INTEGER,
        num_handles INTEGER,
        gdi_objects INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        user_objects INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        username TEXT,
        read_bytes_sec REAL,
        write_bytes_sec REAL,
        read_bytes INTEGER,
        write_bytes INTEGER,
        read_operations INTEGER,
        write_operations INTEGER,
        integrity_level TEXT,
        elevation INTEGER,
        ppid INTEGER,
        parent_name TEXT,
        executable TEXT,
        cmdline TEXT,
        sid TEXT,
        session_id INTEGER,
        creation_time REAL,
        exit_time REAL,
        is_alive INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        process_guid TEXT,
        ancestor_chain TEXT,
        launch_reason TEXT,
        user_time_sec REAL,
        kernel_time_sec REAL,
        total_cpu_time_sec REAL,
        total_context_switches INTEGER,
        cpu_cycles INTEGER,
        open_files_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        tcp_connections_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        udp_sockets_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        sockets_json TEXT,
        open_files_json TEXT,
        leak_risk_score TEXT,
        is_outlier INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        raw_json TEXT,
        FOREIGN KEY (snapshot_id) REFERENCES system_snapshots (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    )

name: sensor_polls

        onedrive_json TEXT,
        battery_json TEXT,
        ram_sticks_json TEXT,
        listening_ports_json TEXT,
        alerts_json TEXT,
        cpu_total_percent REAL,
        cpu_frequency_mhz REAL,
        cpu_temp_c REAL,

name: telemetry_rollups
sql:
CREATE TABLE telemetry_rollups (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        tier TEXT NOT NULL,
        sensor_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '__system__',
        bucket_start REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
        bucket_end REAL,
        period_start TEXT,
        period_end TEXT,
        period_start_epoch REAL,
        period_end_epoch REAL,
        hardware_type TEXT,
        sensor_category TEXT,
        sensor_name TEXT,
        unit TEXT,
        sample_count INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        value_min REAL,
        value_max REAL,
        value_avg REAL,
        value_sum REAL,
        value_sum_sq REAL,
        value_stddev REAL,
        value_first REAL,
        value_last REAL,
        min_val REAL,
        max_val REAL,
        avg_val REAL,
        p95_val REAL,
        sum_val REAL,
        last_val REAL,
        cpu_avg REAL,
        cpu_max REAL,
        cpu_p95 REAL,
        ram_avg REAL,
        ram_max REAL,
        ram_used_gb_avg REAL,
        disk_read_bps_avg REAL,
        disk_write_bps_avg REAL,
        disk_read_bps_max REAL,
        disk_write_bps_max REAL,
        net_sent_bps_avg REAL,
        net_recv_bps_avg REAL,
        gpu_load_avg REAL,
        gpu_temp_max REAL,
        session_id TEXT,
        payload_json TEXT,
        created_at REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
        UNIQUE(tier, sensor_id, bucket_start)
    )
